expectedIssues: Promo banner text is unreadable, white text on a pale mint background
reportedIssues: The promo banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') is white/very light on a pale mint-green background, making it barely readable and failing WCAG contrast requirements.
A category filter chip after 'Healthy' is clipped almost entirely off the right edge, appearing as a sliver of an empty pill with no visible label.
In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third restaurant name is cut off mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol...') without an ellipsis, looking abruptly clipped.
The '3 free deliveries' banner CTA area and text alignment feel unbalanced because the low-contrast text makes the 'Order now' button appear to float in an empty green block.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 explicitly describes the promo banner's white text on a pale mint background as unreadable due to low contrast.
